provenance.ownerStatement:
I adopt the following bounded product amendment for
ky_protective_order_record_expungement-set only.

Apply it to the KY service-amendment draft reported at b70e12976.
This instruction controls if the draft contains broader language.

ADOPTED CHANGE
Remove the unconditional KY.memo.json promise that the packet “provides
the certificate.” Retain the required service-instructions component,
movant service with clerk fallback, and every applicable notice, service,
recipient, timing, and proof-of-service obligation.

Point the manual notice/distribution step to AOC-275.18’s relevant section.
Do not describe that section as a certificate or proof of completed service.

REQUIRED SAFEGUARD
Removing the generated-certificate promise does not waive applicable
proof-of-service requirements, including CR 5.03 where applicable.
Preserve the distinction between actual movant service and actual clerk
service. Do not generate fictional attestations or have the participant
certify the clerk’s actions.

Do not require a universal new affidavit solely because the earlier research
handoff proposed one. Explain the applicable service-documentation pathway;
do not replace it with an unsupported “no proof required” instruction.

IMPLEMENTATION
Preserve the original draft and prior findings.
Record this actual owner instruction with its precise scope.
Use the already-held Manual evidence and record its exact section/version.
Change only the affected KY governing language, instructions, and tests.

Reverify that both service pathways remain covered, clerk-controlled fields
remain protected, and no notice or proof obligation disappeared.
Retain unchanged evidence where dependency checks permit; obtain fresh
evidence for changed PDFs through the existing acceptance process.

This is owner product adoption only, not counsel approval, packet PASS,
terminal promotion, or production authorization.

Continue NH, Act 346, and Kansas independently.

supportingManual.sourceFact: The movant may have served copies; when not already done, the clerk serves copies per the distribution list by first-class mail. This passage does not prescribe a certificate or waive otherwise applicable proof rules.

effectiveFieldReplacements.before: The Clerks' Manual directs that if the movant has not already served copies of the notice per the distribution list by first class mail, the clerk does. The packet tells the movant how to serve and provides the certificate.
effectiveFieldReplacements.after: The Clerks' Manual directs that if the movant has not already served copies of the notice per the distribution list by first class mail, the clerk does. The required service-instructions component explains both service pathways and every applicable notice, recipient, timing, and proof-of-service obligation, including CR 5.03 where applicable. AOC-275.18's notification section and Copies to list identify notice/distribution controls; neither is a certificate or proof of completed service. The packet does not unconditionally promise a generated certificate or impose a universal affidavit. Applicable service documentation must describe actual acts by the actual server; the participant must not certify the clerk's actions. No proof obligation is waived.
AOC-275.18 notification-of-expungement-hearing section and printed Copies to distribution list (notice/distribution controls, not proof of completed service)
